name: Meridian Ledger Labs, Inc.
business: Blockchain monitoring and API SaaS; company-owned funds only; no custody or token issuance

assumptions.valuation: USDC fixed at $1 solely for this simulation; tracked separately from bank cash
assumptions.tax: No income/sales tax model; synthetic payroll withholding 20%, employer cost 8%; not statutory rates
assumptions.revenue: Hosted subscription earned monthly; annual advance base billings deferred; monthly usage earned as delivered
assumptions.cash_flow: Bank-only management cash-flow view; USDC purchases/redemptions shown as investing. Not a standards-compliant statement classification opinion.
assumptions.settlement: SIM identifiers; sponsored network gas charged as USD provider fee; no native gas token model
assumptions.population: 48 staff,120 customers,60 vendors in scope throughout, not a hiring or customer acquisition simulation
assumptions.period: 18-month established-business scenario initialized at zero balances immediately before seed financing
